{"claims": [
  {"type": "tool_used", "quote": "The project uses bun workspaces for package management.", "subject": "bun", "tool_category": "package_manager", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "tool_used", "quote": "The project uses Turborepo for task local & remote caching.", "subject": "Turborepo", "tool_category": "build_tool", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "path_exists", "quote": "- packages/ - Contains all workspace packages (relico, tsconfig, etc)", "subject": "packages/", "path_components": ["packages/"], "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "path_exists", "quote": "- apps/ - Application definitions split by service (cli, scripts, etc)", "subject": "apps/", "path_components": ["apps/"], "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "dependency", "quote": "- This project uses @reliverse/dler to manage bun monorepos easily", "subject": "@reliverse/dler", "ecosystem_hint": "npm", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "command", "quote": "You can check dler's available commands with dler --help", "subject": "--help", "runner": "dler", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "command", "quote": "Use dler update to update all dependencies in monorepo", "subject": "update", "runner": "dler", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "tool_used", "quote": "This project uses Ultracite, a zero-config preset that enforces strict code quality standards through automated formatting and linting.", "subject": "Ultracite", "tool_category": "linter_formatter", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "command", "quote": "- Format code: bunx ultracite fix", "subject": "fix", "runner": "bun", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "command", "quote": "- Check for issues: bunx ultracite check", "subject": "check", "runner": "bun", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "command", "quote": "- Diagnose setup: bunx ultracite doctor", "subject": "doctor", "runner": "bun", "mode": "asserts_existing"},
  {"type": "tool_used", "quote": "Biome (the underlying engine) provides robust linting and formatting.", "subject": "Biome", "tool_category": "linter_formatter", "mode": "asserts_existing"}
]}
